Essential Utilities, Inc. delivers safe, clean, reliable services that improve quality of life for individuals, families, and entire communities.

Operating as the Aqua (water and wastewater services) and the Peoples and Delta (natural gas) brands, Essential serves approximately 5.5 million people across 10 states. We are committed to sustainable growth, operational excellence, a superior customer experience, and premier employer status - including a competitive and comprehensive benefits package as well as a commitment to career growth opportunities.

We are advocates for the communities we serve and are dedicated stewards of natural lands, protecting more than 7,600 acres of forests and other habitats throughout our footprint.

Our company is one of the most significant publicly traded water, wastewater service and natural gas providers in the U.S.

Are you looking for a Finance Internship at People's Natural Gas, a subsidiary of Essential Utilities? We are currently hiring for a full-time intern available from May through August!

Support the accounting, rates and finance activities of the organization.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES:
• Support the maintenance of the Company’s Accounting records in compliance with GAAP and Regulatory Accounting standards which could include anything from bank account reconciliations and preparation of journal entries to redesign of complicated excel models.
• Assists with other tasks or projects as assigned which can range from routine projects to the solving of more complex problems or support in preparing presentations for executives.
• Should expect a tailored approach based on current needs of the business.
• Participate in closing functions with parent company under supervision of lead accountant.

QUALIFICATIONS:
• Student pursuing Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in accounting, finance or related field.
• Must be currently enrolled in college and must have completed (at least) their sophomore year with a specific or relevant major and a GPA greater than 3.0.
• Intellectually curious and adaptable.
• Demonstrated strength in attention-to-detail.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:
• Strong computer skills (Excel, PowerPoint,), problem assessment and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to evaluate large data sets and manage data to support accounting systems, budgeting and cost control principles.
• Strong communication (oral and written) skills.
• Ability to produce and manage several projects in a quality and timely manner.

EXPERIENCE/EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS:
• Student pursuing a Bachelor degree in accounting/finance or related field.
• Demonstrated experience and skill in attention-to-detail.
• Knowledge of federal, state, and local relevant regulations.

WORKING CONDITIONS/PHYSICAL DEMANDS:
• Working conditions may include approximately 10% travel to work sites of PNG & PTWP and/or other constituents.
• Perform sedentary work- exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally, and/or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull, or otherwise move objects, including the human body. Sedentary work involves sitting most of the time.
• See, hear, talk, and perform tasks requiring manual dexterity.
• Operate standard office equipment.

Intern Software Engineer (Summer 2026) job at Veeva Systems. Pleasanton, CA.

Veeva Systems is building the industry cloud for Life Sciences to help companies work in a more efficient and connected way. Learn more about our products, vision and values, and status as a public benefit corporation on our website .

The Role

We are hiring university interns to grow the next generation of Software Engineers through our Engineering Development Program .

We believe in pushing high potential people to achieve excellence. Our program is specifically designed to provide a challenging environment to learn quickly and deliver value early, equipping you with the resources to become an excellent engineer.

REQUIREMENTS | We are looking for graduates who meet the following requirements:
• Graduating Spring 2027 or earlier with a Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field from an accredited 4 year university with a 3.0 to 4.0 GPA
• Must have taken relevant C.S. classes, including at least one Compilers or Operating Systems class. The Fundamentals are important at Veeva
• High work ethic. Veeva is a hard-working company
• High integrity and honesty. Veeva is a PBC and a “do the right thing” company. We expect that from all employees
• Excellent verbal and written English communication skills. Engineering is not all about the code, it’s also about communication
• 0-1 years of professional software experience. We have other jobs for more experienced hires, but our internship is designed for university students just getting going in their careers
• Ability and desire to work in office 4 days/week for the duration of your internship

OUR TECHNOLOGY | We have a variety of different products and codebases, but in general, we use this tech stack:
• System software is Java or Rust
• Application logic is Java, Python, TypeScript
• Front end is JavaScript, React, TypeScript
• Mobile is Swift, Kotlin, React Native

THE PROCESS | Our process is different than most. It is designed to be fast, efficient and respectful. Here are the steps:
• You submit your resume, short cover letter of questions, and take a personality test
• Within one week we will notify you via email if we would like to go to the next step or not
• The next step is a 1 hour online coding challenge in Java or Python
• After the coding challenge, the next step is a single 2-hour interview with a member of our tech evaluation team. Part of this is a coding exercise in the language of your choice (Java, JavaScript or Python)
• Within one week after this step, we will give you an offer, or let you know that we do not wish to move forward
• You will have two weeks to accept our offer or not. If you accept, we will hold a spot for you and expect you to show up on your start date. Accepting an offer and continuing to interview would be an ethical violation in our view
• When you join you will be assigned to an engineering manager in your work location. It’s important to know you are applying to work as an engineer in a location but not applying for a specific team/product

Compensation
• Base pay for this role is $40/hr USD in Pleasanton

Work Authorization : Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to be employed in the United States. Veeva does not provide sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H-1B, OPT, or TN status) for this employment position.

Work Environment : Veeva is a Work Anywhere company. You can choose to work in an office or remotely from home on any given day of the week. Although Veeva is Work from Anywhere, Intern Software Engineers must live within a maximum commuting distance of 45 minutes to 1 hour from their home office and must work in-office 4 days a week.

TTM Technologies, Inc. - Publicly Traded US Company, NASDAQ (TTMI) - Top-5 Global Printed Circuit Board Manufacturer

About TTM

TTM Technologies, Inc. is a leading global manufacturer of technology products, including mission systems, radio frequency ("RF") components, RF microwave/microelectronic assemblies, and technologically advanced printed circuit boards ("PCB"s). TTM stands for time-to-market, representing how TTM's time-critical, one-stop design, engineering and manufacturing services enable customers to reduce the time required to develop new products and bring them to market.

Additional information can be found at www.ttm.com

Scope:

We are seeking high-potential undergraduate and graduate students to join our Finance Internship Program - a structured, cohort-based summer experience embedded within our corporate Finance organization. Interns will contribute to real deliverables across core finance functions while developing critical digital skills in automation, data analytics, and artificial intelligence. This program is designed for future finance leaders who are equally comfortable with financial analysis and technology-driven problem solving in a complex, government-contract-intensive environment.

Scope of Work & Functional Assignments

Interns will be placed in one or more of the following functional areas based on academic background, business need, and career interest:

Financial Planning & Analysis
Budgeting, forecasting, and long-range planning; monthly/quarterly variance analysis; executive dashboard development; AI-assisted scenario modeling and predictive analytics.

Financial Reporting
U.S. GAAP financial statement preparation and review; month-end/quarter-end close support; SEC reporting exposure; automated reconciliation workflows and anomaly detection tools.

Shared Services
AP/AR, general ledger, and transactional finance operations; process improvement and SOP documentation; automation of manual workflows; cross-functional collaboration with Procurement and HR.

Internal Audit
Risk-based audit engagements; SOX ICFR control testing and workpaper documentation; ERM framework exposure; full-population data analysis; AI-driven continuous monitoring techniques.

Tax
Federal, state, and international tax compliance; ASC 740 tax provision; R&D credits and government contracting tax incentives; automated data extraction and regulatory research using AI tools.

Automation, Efficiency & AI Integration
Across all functional areas, interns are expected to apply and develop skills in the following digital finance tools and technologies - central to our Finance Digital Transformation initiative: Alteryx, Tableau, Artificial Intelligence & Automation

Note: The statements herein are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees and are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel. Furthermore, they do not establish a contract for employment and are subject to change at the discretion of the employer.

Education and Experience:

Education:
• Pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or Information Systems

Required Experience:
• Minimum cumulative GPA of 3.0/4.0
• Strong analytical and quantitative skills; high attention to detail
• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel; working knowledge of PowerPoint and Word
• Effective written and verbal communication
• Effective time management

Preferred Experience
• Hands-on experience with Alteryx, Tableau, or similar analytics tools
• Familiarity with AI, machine learning, or automation concepts in a finance context

Program Highlights
• Mentorship: Paired 1:1 with a dedicated finance mentor plus access to executive speaker series and coffee chats.
• Structured Learning: Hands-on training in a variety of financial disciplines and leadership development sessions.
• Capstone Project: Each intern completes a capstone project presented to CFO-organization leadership at the end of the program.

Work Environment
• Full-time, 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday
• On-site at Corporate Headquarters (hybrid flexibility may apply depending on assignment)
• Duration: 8-10 weeks - exact start/end dates confirmed upon offer

Equal Opportunity Employer: All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

Compensation:

Compensation ranges for roles at TTM Technologies varies depending on a wide array of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At TTM Technologies, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on each individual set of circumstances. A reasonable estimate of the current range is:
$31,384 - $47,076

Additional compensation: An annual or quarterly company bonus may apply based on position assignment. Positions hired for alternative shift may be eligible for a shift premium based on the assigned shift and location.

Export Statement:
Must comply with TTM Export Control Policies and Procedures and all applicable laws including ITAR, EAR and OFAC including but not limited to: a) being able to identify ITAR product on the manufacturing floor and understand that access to these products and related technical data is restricted to only US Citizens and US Permanent Residents; b) recognition of Foreign Person visitors by badge differentiation; c) understand and follow authorization procedures for bringing foreign visitors into facilities (VAL); d) understand the Export and ITAR requirements for shipments leaving the US; e) manage vendor approvals for ITAR manufacturing and services.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship, disability or protected veteran status.

We are Generac, a leading energy technology company committed to powering a smarter world.

Over the 60 plus years of Generac’s history, we’ve been dedicated to energy innovation. From creating the home standby generator market category, to our current evolution into an energy technology solutions company, we continue to push new boundaries.

Our internship program at Generac is designed to give students a chance to develop their business and technical skills by assisting with ongoing and project related activities within our accounting department. This internship will introduce the candidate to the cost accounting function. The candidate’s time may include activities such as new part product costing, operations reporting and analyzing COGS variances and will support various “continuous improvement” projects. At the conclusion of this internship, the candidate will have a working knowledge of product costing within a multi-billion dollar public company.

The position is available as a full time internship on site during the summer. Additional on-going hours during the school year will also be considered, depending on candidate preference.

Major Responsibilities

Assist Cost Accounting team with daily/monthly close activities including but not limited to the following:
• Reviewing new product creations and raw material adds for accurate data and costing
• Assist Cost Accounting team with identifying and reviewing purchase price variances (PPV) and driving resolution
• Maintain and distribute labor reporting to production plants
• Analyze cycle count and scrapping adjustments to ensure accuracy and SOX compliance
• Project related work that might include: enhancing the cost roll analysis for our business group partners, producing analysis and contributing to the month end close process for the Cost Accounting team.
• Complete other projects as assigned.

Minimum Job Requirements

Education
• Currently enrolled in a bachelor’s program with an emphasis in Accounting or Finance
• Minimum 3.0 GPA

Knowledge / Skills / Abilities
• Microsoft Excel experience
• Conscientious, self-motivated worker with attention to detail
• Ability to work independently and in a group setting
• Dependable and organized

Preferred Job Requirements

Education
• Sophomore year status or higher

Knowledge / Skills / Abilities
• Flexibility to work in a fast-paced environment with multiple demands requiring initiative and independence
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office programs
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Physical Demands: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk and hear; and use hands to manipulate objects or controls. The employee is regularly required to stand and walk. On occasion the incumbent may be required to stoop, bend or reach above the shoulders. The employee must occasionally lift up to 25 - 50 pounds. Specific conditions of this job are typical of frequent and continuous computer-based work requiring periods of sitting, close vision and ability to adjust focus. Occasional travel.

Are you ready to explore the world of aerospace and defense? Do you want to learn from and collaborate with some of the greatest minds in the industry? At RTX, our internships, co-ops, and full-time careers provide an exceptional foundation to work on complex problems, advance your skills and create a safer, more connected world. Discover opportunities to make a difference at RTX.

What You Will Do:

As a Software Tools Engineering Intern, you will support the development and enhancement of engineering tools used in the design, verification, and certification of avionics software systems. These tools improve the productivity, quality, and traceability of safety-critical software developed under aerospace standards such as DO-178C.

During this internship you will:
• Assist in developing and maintaining software tools used by avionics engineering teams.
• Support automation of software development and verification workflows.
• Contribute to scripts and utilities used for data processing, reporting, and engineering analytics.
• Help integrate engineering tools with systems such as requirements management, issue tracking, and configuration management.
• Develop enhancements to internal pipelines that support software build, analysis, testing, and traceability.
• Assist in generating reports and dashboards that provide insight into engineering metrics such as testing progress, requirement coverage, and development trends.
• Work with experienced engineers to improve tooling used for safety-critical software development.
• Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and team planning sessions.

What You Will Learn

Through this internship you will gain hands-on experience in aerospace software development environments and modern engineering toolchains.

You will learn about:
• Software development processes used in certified avionics systems
• Aerospace development standards such as DO-178C
• Development of engineering productivity tools and automation
• Integration of tools with platforms such as Git, CI/CD pipelines, requirements management systems, and defect tracking systems
• Best practices in software configuration management and traceability
• Data analysis and reporting for engineering metrics
• Working in a collaborative Agile engineering environment

You will also gain exposure to real-world avionics development programs and how engineering tools support safe and reliable aircraft systems.

Qualifications You Must Have
• Requires a High School Diploma or equivalent and student must be pursuing a Bachelor's or advanced degree in an applicable discipline.

Qualifications We Prefer
• Experience writing scripts or automation tools using Python.
• Familiarity with Linux based development environments.
• Understanding of software build systems or CI/CD pipelines.
• Interest in aerospace, embedded systems, or safety-critical software development.
• Familiarity with tools such as:

GitHub / GitLab

JIRA

Requirements management tools (e.g., Jama, DOORS)
• Coursework or projects related to embedded systems, software testing, or software engineering processes.
